title: Intake Coordinator
why_it_fits: Virtual Assistant match. 3 skills: excel, data entry, admin. Likely PH eligibility signal

position_overview: New Therapy Perspectives , LLC is "The" provider of quality intensive outpatient services. We provide custom, confidential, and comprehensive care both in-person and virtually to those affected by a multitude of mental health challenges as well as those who are affected by substance use disorders. We are discreet and innovative while providing new treatment perspectives to those in seeking assistance. We believe that all people can make positive changes in their lives and build resiliency and we strive to enhance and to restore the worth and dignity of all individuals in need of treatment. We provide intensive outpatient services to adults and teens who suffer from mental health, substance abuse, emotional conditions, and mental health and substance abuse co-occurring disorders. Job Details Title: Intake Coordinator Description: Under the Supervision of the CEO while functioning in the capacity of Intake Coordinator will conduct initial intakes, ensure potential patients are eligible for care, and enter their data into the EMR System. The coordinator is also expected to update the medical records of existing patients. Applicants should have experience in an administrative role, preferably in a medical office, and excellent data entry and technical skills. Intake Coordinator Requirements: Bachelor's Degree OR 3-5 years Medical Office Administration experience Valid driver's license with clean driving record and state minimum required vehicle insurance coverage Being bilingual is not required but is a preferred skill for this position Able to pass a Level II background check Experience with health insurance a plus Patient scheduling experience a plus Bilingual communication skills a plus Originally posted on Himalayas
